verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair question for a developer-workflow client, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows GitHub Mobile itself letting users define rules that fire actions on events. The mobile app's documented features are reviewing, triaging, notifications and managing Copilot agent tasks. Event- and schedule-driven automations are documented only for Copilot cloud agent on GitHub.com and for GitHub Actions, which are host-platform capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
